systems.owner: Agence Nationale du Registre des Populations et des Titres Sécurisés (ANRPTS), Ministère de l'Intérieur
systems.tiers: A box in the architecture diagram of the Registre National Biométrique des Populations, beside AFIS Civil; the deck does not say what it does or who uses it

systems.country_label: Système intégré de Gestion des Populations et des Titres Sécurisés (SIGPTS)
systems.tiers: National biometric population register with control and verification stations, crossing points (points de passage), consulates and citizen reception centres; the deck gives its purposes as identifying citizens and residents, securing titles and managing migration flows

The deck says digital services are interconnected through Houwiyeti and the NNI, and its diagram lists 'Police, sécurité' among the connected parties with ministries, telecom operators, banks and platforms; no tier stated

note: An ANRPTS slide deck on the population register; it states nothing about police stations or their records. 'AFIS Criminel' is a diagram label only, so its class is left empty.
